profile_text.body:
Teradata Corp /DE/ is a public company headquartered in San Diego, California, traded under the ticker TDC. On its own website the company describes itself as the AI platform for the autonomous era, connecting and scaling across any environment, and presents its Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform as a way to make AI real, trusted, governed, and built to scale. It says its product and service portfolio covers AI, analytics, and cloud solutions, and that it partners with other providers to supply technology, AI-driven resources, and knowledge to customers.

The site frames AI as reshaping how business runs and positions Teradata's platform as the means to act on that change. Beyond the platform name and the general description of the portfolio, the harvested site text does not name specific products or executives.

The company's litigation record shows 281 cases in California. It holds SEC registration with CIK 0000816761.
